title: C++: GC (Mark-Sweep)
description: Simulate a mark-and-sweep garbage collector with an object graph.

steps.title: GC Simulation
steps.description: Create an Object class with a bool marked flag and vector<Object*> children. Maintain a global heap of all objects. Implement mark(Object* root) that recursively marks reachable objects, and sweep() that frees unmarked objects.
hints: void mark() { if (marked) return; marked = true; for (auto child : children) child->mark(); }
void sweep() { auto it = remove_if(heap.begin(), heap.end(), [](Object* o) { ... }); }
